KWA Holdings
Stake: 26.4%
Sector: Beverages
Kenya Wine Agencies is a leading manufacturer and distributor of wines
and spirits in East Africa with operations in Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda.
The company produces, packages and distributes both alcoholic and
non-alcoholic beverages.
The company has partnerships with leading international distilleries and
foreign brand owners from which it sources wines and spirits which it
then distributes under license.
